# Disposable telemetry link transactions

Run `python3 packages/tests/fixtures/telemetry-link-convex/run.py` from a clean committed candidate only. The supervisor requires free loopback ports 3540/3541, verifies the selected auth archive against installed bytes, denies outbound network in a macOS sandbox, creates a fresh private database, disables beacon and telemetry before sync, and checks Boat is empty and other provider configuration absent. It stops only its own backend and retains private fixture data and logs.

The fixture re-exports the product's registered claim, link lookup, attempt reservation and acknowledgement functions. It replaces **only** the scheduled link transport with an inert action; tests exercise actual Convex transactions using synthetic user IDs, not real sessions or actual PostHog delivery. Parallel requests cover contention on the same anonymous capability and on the same attempt. The fixture does not invoke the page or bootstrap HTTP handlers: the production telemetry gate is disabled throughout, so HTTP integration and browser identity need separate proof. Root must exclude this product-only fixture and test from generated starters.
